resum: Wall Street bounced back on Wednesday (Nasdaq +1.60%, S&P 500 +1.29%) thanks to CoreWeave, European stocks closed at a record and Spain's Ibex finished above 20,000 points (+0.46%) despite the general strike. The key story: Nvidia is down 8% after hours because its board is reportedly preparing to oust Jensen Huang, according to The Wall Street Journal.
destacat: A giant company can depend too much on a single person: when its leader wobbles, the market judges not just the numbers but also who makes the decisions and who keeps them in check.
